content.assumptions: Let A ⊆ B(Hₐₜ) be the fixed unital C*-algebra obtained by adjoining the chosen shell-link unitaries to the atomic representation of the CAR algebra C, and then taking the norm-closed unital *-algebra they generate. This is an unconditional theorem about that fixed construction, with no CH assumption.
content.display_title: The underlying set of A has cardinality continuum
content.lean_realization_notes: This declaration concerns carrier cardinality. The exact norm-density theorem for A is a separate result; neither is a statement about Hamel dimension.
content.natural_language_statement: The underlying set of the fixed CAR-based C*-algebra A has cardinality exactly 𝔠 = 2^ℵ₀.
content.one_sentence_role: Identifies the exact cardinality of the same fixed algebra.

proof_steps.text: Use the upper bound for the cardinality of A to obtain |A| ≤ 𝔠.
The whole carrier is norm dense in itself, so the lower bound for all norm-dense subsets of A gives 𝔠 ≤ |A|.

content.proof_summary: Combine the upper bound from the faithful separable representation with the dense-set lower bound applied to the whole space A.

/-- The cardinality of the underlying set of the fixed algebra is continuum. -/
theorem cardinalMk_atomicCounterexampleAlgebra :
    #AtomicCounterexampleAlgebra = Cardinal.continuum := by
  apply le_antisymm cardinalMk_atomicCounterexampleAlgebra_le_continuum
  simpa using continuum_le_cardinalMk_dense_atomicCounterexampleAlgebra Set.univ dense_univ
